signal.fake_payment_proof: Sends a fake receipt or says "I sent too much, send it back"
signal.impersonation: Pretends to be ShopNexus, a bank or a carrier
signal.off_app_contact: Asks to move to Zalo, Telegram or Facebook
signal.prepayment_request: Asks for money or a deposit up front
signal.sensitive_info_request: Asks for a sign-in code, password or card details
signal.suspicious_link: Sends odd links or fake payment or delivery pages
